final_text: The General Fund revised budget for FY2026 was $10.19bn, against an adopted budget of $9.56bn. Committed spend was $9.72bn, a utilisation of 95.4%, leaving $471.2m unspent. Departments with the lowest utilisation: General Services used 71.6% of a $397.9m budget; Non-Departmental - General City Purposes used 71.8% of a $263.5m budget; Mayor used 76.6% of a $89.1m budget.
